title: Broadway Bound
intro: [excited] Welcome to Broadway Bound! Tonight the curtain rises on Disney's stage shows, from Times Square to the theme parks. [whispers] Please silence your cell phones... unless you're buzzing in.

art.prompt: A glittering Broadway theater district at night, a red velvet curtain rising on an empty stage lit by a golden spotlight, giant savanna puppets and an ice palace set waiting in the wings, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: The Great White Way
categories.intro: Our first category is The Great White Way, all about Disney on Broadway. [chuckles] Jazz hands are encouraged.

art.prompt: A row of glowing old-fashioned theater marquee lights with blank signs along a rainy Times Square street at night, reflections in the puddles, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Disney's very first Broadway musical, which opened in 1994, was based on this 1991 animated film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! [excited] It ran for more than thirteen years. Be our guest, indeed.

clues.clue: Famous for giant puppet giraffes and elephants, this Disney musical is the highest-grossing show in Broadway history.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King! [gasps] It opened in 1997 and has earned BILLIONS. Hakuna matata, no money worries.

clues.clue: This 2014 Disney musical stops the show with a huge tap-dancing Friend Like Me.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [laughs] The Genie number gets a standing ovation in the middle of Act One. The actor needs a nap after.

clues.clue: The Lion King's director made history in 1998 as the first woman to win the Tony for directing a musical.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Julie Taymor! She also designed many of the masks and puppets. [excited] Talk about multitasking.

clues.clue: Disney restored this historic 42nd Street theater, which opened The Lion King on Broadway in 1997.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the New Amsterdam Theatre! [whispers] The Lion King later moved to the Minskoff in 2006. Tricky, tricky.

categories.title: From Screen to Stage
categories.intro: Next up, From Screen to Stage! Every one of these musicals started as a Disney movie. [mischievously] Some were hits... and some were rescued by Broadway.

art.prompt: A film reel unspooling from a movie projector and turning into a theater stage floor with footlights, newspapers, jungle vines and snowflakes swirling above it, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In the Broadway musical of this film, Elsa's Let It Go brings down the curtain on Act One.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen! [excited] Her dress transforms right on stage in the blink of an eye. Theater magic!

clues.clue: A young Christian Bale starred in this 1992 Disney movie musical about striking newsboys, which became a 2012 Broadway hit.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Newsies! [laughs] The movie flopped, then kids wore out the VHS tapes. Now everybody wants to seize the day.

clues.clue: Tarzan's 2006 Broadway musical featured songs by this rock star, who also wrote the film's songs.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phil Collins! [chuckles] You'll Be in My Heart. And now you'll be humming it all night.

clues.clue: In The Little Mermaid on Broadway in 2008, the merfolk swam across the stage by gliding on these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Heelys! [laughs] Sneakers with a wheel in the heel. Ariel's tail had a secret set of wheels.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins flew onto Broadway in 2006 as a co-production between Disney and this legendary British producer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cameron Mackintosh! [excited] The man behind Les Miserables and Cats. And in the stage show, Mary flies right over the audience.

categories.title: Spotlight Zoom
categories.intro: It's our zoom category, Spotlight Zoom! You'll start super close on a stage set and slowly pull back. [whispers] Break a leg.

art.prompt: A theater spotlight beam cutting through haze onto a stage covered with tiny miniature sets: a savanna, an ice palace, a golden cave, a city street and a jungle, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Zoom out on this stage set. Which Disney stage musical is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Little Mermaid! [excited] Under the sea, on a stage, with no actual water. Darling, it's better... down where it's dry.

media.prompt: A stage set of an underwater kingdom with a giant scallop-shell throne, glowing jellyfish lanterns floating on wires and a rocky grotto shelf full of human trinkets like a fork and a pipe, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Zoom out on this stage set. Which Disney stage musical is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mary Poppins! [chuckles] Chimneys, rooftops, and a nanny who flies over the audience. Step in time!

clues.clue: Zoom out on this stage set. Which Disney stage musical is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Hunchback of Notre Dame! [whispers] The stage version features a full choir right on stage. Sanctuary!

media.prompt: A stage set of a Gothic cathedral bell tower with enormous bronze bells hanging from wooden beams, stained-glass rose window glowing behind, a choir loft in shadow and a tiny carved wooden village on a table, original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos

clues.clue: Zoom out on this stage set. Which Disney stage musical is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tarzan! [excited] The actors swung on ropes right over the audience. Front-row seats came with a breeze.

clues.clue: Zoom out on this stage set. Which Disney stage musical is it?
accept: elton john and tim rice's aida
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aida! [gasps] Disney's 2000 Broadway musical with songs by Elton John and Tim Rice. It won four Tony Awards, and it's not based on a cartoon at all.

categories.title: Showtime in the Parks
categories.intro: Time for the parks: Showtime in the Parks! [excited] No Broadway tickets needed. Just a park ticket... and a LOT of sunscreen.

art.prompt: An outdoor theme park amphitheater at night with a lagoon stage, water screens, colorful fountains and lights, with a jungle theater in the round nearby, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Festival of the Lion King is a big, colorful stage show at this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Animal Kingdom! [excited] Stilt walkers, tumbling monkeys and giant floats. It's been roaring since 1998.

clues.clue: In Fantasmic, Mickey wears the starry sorcerer's hat from this 1940 film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasia! [laughs] Mickey borrowed it from the sorcerer Yen Sid. Spoiler, it did not go well the first time.

clues.clue: At Disney's Hollywood Studios, Fantasmic plays in this huge lakeside theater.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hollywood Hills Amphitheater! [chuckles] Room for thousands of guests. Get there early, because it fills up FAST.

clues.clue: Beauty and the Beast Live on Stage plays at this outdoor Sunset Boulevard theater at Disney's Hollywood Studios.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Theater of the Stars! [excited] Be Our Guest with dancing plates, live, under the Florida sun. Bravo!

clues.clue: Disney California Adventure's Hyperion Theater is named after the street of Walt's studio, where this first full-length animated feature was made.
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs! [whispers] Made on Hyperion Avenue in Los Angeles, released in 1937. Heigh-ho!

categories.title: Finish the Showtune
categories.intro: Our fan category is Finish the Showtune! I'll sing the start, you finish the line. [laughs] Please, PLEASE buzz in fast so I stop singing.

art.prompt: Glowing golden music notes and lyrics swirling out of an old-fashioned theater orchestra pit into a starry sky above a red curtain, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Finish the lyric: Hakuna matata, what a wonderful...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is phrase! [laughs] Hakuna matata, ain't no passing craze. Okay, okay, I'll stop.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric: Be our guest, be our guest, put our... to the test.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is service! [excited] Tie your napkin round your neck, cherie. Dinner is served.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric: Wish I could be part of that...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is world! [sighs] Ariel collecting forks and dreaming big. On Broadway she gets a whole new set of songs, too.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric: I can show you the world, shining, shimmering...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is splendid! [chuckles] Tell me, princess, now when did you last let your heart decide? Romance on a rug.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric: He lives in you, he lives in me, he watches over everything we...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is see! [excited] He Lives in You is a showstopper in The Lion King on Broadway. Shivers!
